title: Desk laptop opener into a voiced editor step tutorial
summary: A filmed laptop on a dark desk shows a finished phone render, then the film becomes a screen capture on a blue backdrop that walks through each editor step under VO. One continuous shot, the result proves the steps.
use_when: A creative tool shows how fast a result is made, step by step, with VO
Vertical social tutorial where the finished output must open the film
A real screen recording exists and each step is one or two clicks
Showing that settings (zoom, tilt, animation, effects, export) change a preview live

look.type_style: no added type: all text is the product UI (small grotesk UI labels, white on dark panels); no captions burned in

sfx.event: cursor click on a sidebar control or menu item (rows 2-7, 9, 11-12)
settings menu or effects list opens (rows 7, 9)
final click on the export button (row 13)

params.brand: brand.json: bg and accent drive the blue gradient backdrop band above and below the capture
params.content.opener: 4-5 s filmed or rendered shot of a laptop showing the finished output
params.content.recording: screen recording of the tool, one take, about 30 s, covering 6-8 steps
params.content.steps: list of {t, target} zoom targets (canvas or sidebar region) the camera visits, one per VO step
params.content.vo: VO script: 11 short phrases, ~104 words over ~32 s (~3.3 words/s), one step per phrase
params.music.bpm: light beat around 122 BPM under the VO, ducked
params.aspect: 9:16; the capture is framed with blue backdrop bands top and bottom

notes: One continuous shot (cuts.json: 0 hard, 0 soft, 0 flashes); near-misses at 4.83, 9.20, 28.73 are camera moves inside the shot, so every transition_out is continuous. The opener is filmed footage of a laptop; from ~4.83 the picture is a screen capture with zooms and pans, the join reads as a push into the screen (not measured frame by frame; 4 fps sheets). VO ~104 words, 0.55-32.55 s, ~3.3 words/s, one step per phrase; music 122.3 BPM (confidence 0.21). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured: clicks are not distinguishable under VO and music. Springs and easings are suggestions; all motion numbers are ±0.25 s from sheets. device-3d: the phone is a 3D device render inside the tool, tilted and rotated. Proposed terms: footage-to-capture handoff, tutorial step zoom.
